label: v2-formalization
prompt:
Formalize every numbered English sentence as one complete executable candidate. Return JSON only. Use domain(person,[all_lowercase_named_entities]) and exactly one axiom(sN, Formula) per source sentence. A fact is exactly axiom(s1, studies(iris)). Use only lower-case unary terms such as studies(iris), not(studies(iris)), and(A,B), or(A,B), xor(A,B), implies(A,B), and forall(var(x,person), Formula); no atom(...), rule, infix operators, ordinary Prolog clauses, directives, files, network, or uppercase variables. For a bare phrase “either A or B”, use or(A,B). Use xor(A,B) only if its text explicitly says “but not both”. If it says “or both”, “both are allowed”, or equivalent, use or(A,B). Preserve every sentence. Query is one lower-case ground unary predicate from the question, using program vocabulary.

World:
s1: Kai reads.
s2: Kai either reads or sketches.

Question:
Does Kai sketch?
